node.title: Re: Escape newlines in POD / (Selectively) don't generate space characters instead
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Doing so, I noticed that perlpod seems to generally replace newlines with space characters (sometimes even multiple ones).

At least for [mod://Pod::Simple], this appears to happen deep within the parser, specifically, [https://metacpan.org/source/KHW/Pod-Simple-3.41/lib/Pod/Simple/BlackBox.pm#L2058|here]. The preserve_whitespace probably wouldn't help here because it would just preserve the newlines. Unfortunately, it looks to me like the "best" choice is to not break L<>s across multiple lines.

but two(!) space characters between continues. and This. I don't want this to happen.

Looking at the output of [mod://pod2man], this appears to be an effect of [wp://roff (software)|*roff] typesetting, see e.g. [https://www.gnu.org/software/groff/manual/html_node/Sentences.html|Sentences] and [https://www.gnu.org/software/groff/manual/html_node/Manipulating-Filling-and-Adjusting.html#index-ss|.ss]. An argument could be made that [mod://Pod::Man] should be merging POD paragraphs into one line to avoid the issue you're seeing.
